name: Uranium & Nuclear Fuel Cycle
edge: Left for dead post-Fukushima; followed by a small specialist crowd.

catalysts.title: Reactor restart / new build approval
catalysts.logic: More reactors online -> higher uranium demand -> bullish miners.

catalysts.title: Producer supply cut / disruption
catalysts.logic: Supply cut (e.g. Kazatomprom) -> tighter spot -> bullish miners.

catalysts.title: Russian enrichment sanctions / ban
catalysts.logic: Sanctions on Russian enrichment -> bullish Western enrichers (LEU).

catalysts.title: SMR / advanced reactor milestone
catalysts.logic: SMR progress / datacenter power deals -> bullish advanced-reactor names.
